source: RFC 2617 s3.5, RFC 7616 s3.9.1; ruby-sdk digest_handler_test.rb; nodejs-sdk@54aeed4 digest.test.ts
note: Each case builds a DigestChallengeHandler (internal constructor: fixed cnonce, md5Available from the case, preference from the case or the default), parses every string in `challenges` with AuthenticationChallenge.Parse, and calls Authorize(method, url). `expected` is null when the handler must decline. The expected Authorization values were generated by an independent Python reference implementation (hashlib), not by the C# code. `second` is the result of a second call with the same challenges (the nonce counter). Wire order of the parameters is this port's own.
